## [Q3LOCK Jensen normalizer sub-obligation audit] - 2026-09-05

This T0 addendum strengthens the Q3LOCK P-06/P-09 finite-time-grid normalizer sub-obligation without changing any claim or publication tier. For the declared centered positive-harmonic temporal Gaussian, the spectral diagonal covariance satisfies g_N(0) <= 1/(beta*a)+beta/(12m) uniformly in the time-grid size. Centered Gaussian second/fourth moments bound the residual Q3LOCK polynomial and spatial bond action at fixed finite volume, and Jensen gives Z_(N,L)(h) >= exp(-beta*V*C_(L,h_0)) uniformly on a compact source interval. The quartic lower bound supplies the matching normalized-weight upper control. This replaces an implicit small-ball denominator step with a direct estimate, but interpolation, Feynman-Kac identification, FKG/FSS transfer, operator/form-domain audit and external review remain open. PDF compilation remains deferred until content freeze.
